steps4000.operator: node-centred trapezoidal area average, factor 4 (geoneural.superres.observe weights): coarse node j averages fine nodes 4j-2..4j+2 with weights [0.5,1,1,1,0.5]/4 per axis (separable), edge windows truncated and renormalised. 1025^2 at 10 m -> 257^2 at 40 m, coarse nodes coincide with every 4th fine node.
steps4000.bicubic: cubic B-spline interpolation of the 257^2 coarse grid, scipy.ndimage.map_coordinates order=3, prefilter, mode=mirror, coarse node j at fine node 4j
steps4000.backProjection: z <- z + bilinear_up(y - Hz) until max|Hz - y| < 1e-4 m

model.type: U-Net, 3 levels, width 32, GELU, no norm layers
model.inputs: bicubic upsample only, as offset-invariant features: central gradients, Laplacian, high-pass (b - gauss2(b)), each divided by a local scale sigma = sqrt(gauss4(|grad b|^2)) + 0.02 m; log(sigma)/2 as a channel; cos(pi/2 * index) phase maps for rows and cols
model.target: (z - bicubic) / sigma, L1 loss on the central 96 of 128 windows
model.features: computed on the field before cropping (margin 16), so training crops and the tiled full-field inference see identical inputs
model.inference: tiles of 256 core + 48 halo, mirror-padded field edges

steps4000.scoring: full 1025^2 field; errors in metres; obs residual over 257^2 coarse nodes; streams = D8 accumulation >= 500 cells after priority-flood fill, same chain on reference and estimate, Jaccard over the full field; streamF1Tol1 = share of stream cells of each mask within 1 cell of the other
steps4000.note: train regions are listed for in-distribution comparison only
steps4000.linearControl:
Extra control for task 1: the optimal linear per-phase upsampler, fitted on the train regions.

Each fine node at phase (i mod 4, j mod 4) is a fixed linear combination of the 8x8 coarse nodes
around it (deviations from their mean, so constants pass through). 16 least-squares fits.
If the CNN's gain over bicubic+bp is matched by this, the learnable signal is a better kernel,
not anything nonlinear. Also a stream-metric noise floor (reference + small white noise).

task1_operatorMismatch_steps10000_model.method:
Task 1 side check: does the CNN gain survive a different observation operator at test time?

The model was trained on the trapezoidal average. Here the held-out coarse grid is built by
(a) plain decimation z[::4, ::4] (point samples) and (b) a 4x4-ish Gaussian average
(sigma 1.5 fine nodes) then decimation. No back-projection (the operator is "unknown").

analyticIncision.note: Exact discrete steady state on the teacher's final D8 network, integrated upstream from the fixed edges. Tolerance 0.1 % of relief.

budget.note: Criterion proposed in the research plan (teacher error below 10 % of the prediction error budget). The dynamics budget of 10 % of the change over the interval and the inverse budget of the observation noise are declared here, not derived.

conservation.note: Zero-flux edges make the discrete Laplacian sum to zero exactly. Boundary outflow is non-zero only under a base level, which makes the system open.

rows.closureNote: observed minus expected, relative to the uplift volume. Diffusion must contribute exactly zero with zero-flux edges; a non-zero diffusion volume is a Laplacian bug, not physics.

conventions.slope: drop to receiver over receiver distance

fastscape.note: Steady states are compared by mean elevation because a steady state depends on the network, and the two codes break D8 ties and fill flats differently; receiverAgreement says how often they chose the same network.

gridRefinement.note: The steady-state exponent is the one property the closed form predicts independently of the mesh, so it is what a grid refinement can falsify. `adequateSpacingM` is the coarsest spacing that still recovers it.

manufacturedDiffusion.note: Manufactured solution with a steady source passed as the spatial uplift field and fixed (Dirichlet) edges. dt is the teacher's own limit, so it scales with dx^2 and the expected order is two.

nonDivisible.note: The odd duration ends with a remainder step; its error against the dt 12.5 reference must be comparable to that of the nearest divisible duration.

results.qualification: These gates establish that the solver integrates the equation it claims to. They establish nothing about whether that equation describes any real landscape: the omissions listed by `evolve` (sediment transport, lithology, flexure, climate, sea level, human alteration) are unaffected by any amount of numerical convergence.

rotation.note: Gate: the quarter turn. The cone numbers are a recorded property of D8: incision only, 20 kyr, on a circular cone whose exact solution is radially symmetric. On the ring between 30 and 70 % of the cone radius, the azimuthal coefficient of variation of the incised depth and the ratio of incision within 3 degrees of the eight D8 directions to incision elsewhere measure how far the routing is from rotational invariance.

steadyState.note: Settled means the rate fell below the threshold and stayed below it for persistenceYears until the end of the run; a first crossing alone is reported but is not the criterion.

timestepRefinement.note: Explicit Euler on this splitting is first order. receiverChangeFraction is the share of cells whose D8 receiver on the final surface differs from the reference run's; receiver switching is discontinuous and is what can pull the observed order below one.

grid.note: jumpFraction: share of neighbouring grid values differing by more than 20 log units

verdict.note: teacher against generic is the experiment: same capacity, same bytes, same input shape, and only the raster's content differs. teacher against none is the confound it controls for: an extra input channel helps whatever is in it. A gain smaller than the seed spread is not a gain.

results.why: The teacher and generic arms are conditioned on a raster built from the full target field (its own D8 paths and slope-area fit). No standalone decoder could build it, and the 24 bytes charged for three scalars do not price the paths. The numbers say whether slope-area structure is informative to a small coordinate network at equal capacity; they are not compression results.
